description: Rete Trasporto Pubblico Locale di Roma Capitale nel is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Roma Capitale. Rete trasporto pubblico locale di Roma Capitale nel 2018. Coverage: Italy. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Roma Capitale. Its tags are trasporti-urbani. It offers 9 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
